claim: Amazon Data Firehose requires a deserializer to read the JSON of your input data. When you combine multiple JSON documents into the same record, the input must still be in the supported JSON format; an array of JSON documents is not a valid input.

evidence.quote: When combining multiple JSON documents into the same record, make sure that your input is still presented in the supported JSON format. An array of JSON documents is not a valid input.
Amazon Data Firehose requires a deserializer to read the JSON of your input data.
